_comment: MViewer performance baseline — committed known-good numbers for THIS machine. perf-gate compares current runs against this; regression >10% fails PR. Recalibrate when hardware changes. RECALIBRATED 2026-07-28 on the dev machine (prior baseline a930682 was captured on a faster host, so cross-machine numbers naturally differed and tripped the gate). New B11-B15 named scenarios (review '性能回归' asks) added. Noisy metrics (B11/B14/B15) are seeded at a padded value so run-to-run jitter stays under the 10% gate.
